disposition_reason: A literature review that compiles bioaccumulation factors and statements from other experimental studies on insects reared for food and feed; it reports no primary measurements.

study.design: literature review of chemical hazards (heavy metals, dioxins/PCBs, PAHs, pesticides, veterinary drugs, mycotoxins, plant toxins) in insects reared for food and feed
study.method: database search (CAB Abstracts, Web of Science, Scopus) of studies published after the 2018 EFSA-era review

controls.control: Substrate composition, yellow mealworm (quoted from Truzzi et al. 2019)
controls.comparator: 100% organic wheat flour vs 75% wheat meal + 25% olive pomace
controls.outcome: Pb BAF 34 vs 6.1 (quoted, not primary data)

controls.control: Substrate packaging, black soldier fly (quoted from Van der Fels-Klerx et al. 2020)
controls.comparator: vegetable substrate in carton vs plastic container
controls.outcome: Cd BAF 20.4 vs 7 (quoted, not primary data)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Table 1 compiles bioaccumulation factors from exposure studies: As 0.5-1.1 (H. illucens), 1.1 (T. molitor); Cd 2.5-20.4 (H. illucens), 0.8-2.5 (T. molitor); Pb 0.03-3.1 (H. illucens), 5.2-34 (T. molitor); Hg 0.5-6.2
EU contaminant framework cited: Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006 (food) and Directive 2002/32/EC (feed)

unresolved: Review quoting other studies; no primary concentration data, so no findings.
